## Install

1. Download **TcgImport-Setup.exe** below (under *Assets*).
2. Run it. Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* because the installer isn't code-signed: click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Click **Install**, then **Finish**. TCG Import starts and has a Start menu shortcut.

Installing a newer version over an older one keeps your favorites and settings.

## Before your first import

In your browser, sign in to [TCG Arena](https://tcg-arena.fr) and add **Magic the Gathering** under **Games** (one time).
TCG Import opens TCG Arena's import page there; click **Import** to save the deck.
